name: The filing fee
note: Doc 23. Earned at A8 by tuning the Nugget's piano, spent at A9 filing the deed.

LOOK_AT.say: Two dollars, earned by tuning a saloon piano that nobody plays.
repeat: Two dollars, going to a man behind a grille to write a number in a book.
The most useful money I have earned in my life, and it is for paperwork.
Nothing. It is two dollars and it will not be two dollars for long.
